IC1: 1. Are referred to the Cachexia Clinic with involuntary weight loss of >5% of their premorbid weight within the previous 6 months.
IC2: 2. Are 18 years of age or older
IC3: 3. Have a Karnofsky performance score of 60 or higher.
IC4: 4. Can maintain oral food intake during the study
IC5: 5. Can understand the study procedures and can sign an informed consent form.
IC7: 7. Are taking megestrol acetate [AND] and continue to lose weight despite at least 2 weeks of therapy.
IC8: 8. Have a calculated creatinine clearance of >/= 60 cc/min.
